title: music-replacements.json and sound-replacements.json
description: Redirects audio owned by another pack to audio owned by this one. Stored at Audio Replacements/<Target Pack>/music-replacements.json and Audio Replacements/<Target Pack>/sound-replacements.json, where <Target Pack> is usually Classic. Each file is a plain object keyed by the target pack's audio name, deserialized as MusicReplacementsData or SoundReplacementsData.

musicReplacements.title: MusicReplacementsData
musicReplacements.description: Keys are Classic music identifiers such as "M00", "M03". Values name the replacement track in the providing pack.

musicName.description: Replacement track, as a base file name without extension, resolved under that pack's Musics/ folder.

soundReplacements.title: SoundReplacementsData
soundReplacements.description: Keys are Classic sound slot numbers written as strings, such as "0", "13". Values name the replacement sound in the providing pack.

soundName.description: Replacement sound, as a base file name without extension, resolved under that pack's Sounds/ folder.
